architecture: v3 (re-root after the cell clash: a Canadian regional health authority's insured population at the end of 2026 for the province's capitation round, the people its registry holds twice since the card renewal campaign estimated as the excess of same-name, same-birthday pairs over chance)
slot_note: re-root of task456 in the same objective (Data Extraction & Conformation), batch 1; architecture 2 (the packaging plant's VOC emissions) abandoned at stage 2 for a same-cell clash with task468 v6; new world, new dataset, new shell
niche: a regional health authority's count of insured persons at 31 December 2026, conformed from the legacy health insurance registry and the new registration platform after the 2026 card renewal campaign, in which residents whose surname had changed could not pass the renewal check and applied as new, so the registry holds some of them twice under two health numbers and two surnames
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the legacy and new-platform extracts, removes the records the registry itself retired, de-duplicates by health number and links the rest probabilistically on given name, surname, birth date, sex and postal code files the linked count of active persons, because every pair that shares a given name, a birth date and a sex but not a surname scores as two people (or, read the other way, files every such pair as one person); the pairs chance alone produces in each birth year's given-name mix are only part of them, the excess is the people the renewal campaign registered twice, and the insured count lands between the two readings, below the linked count by a margin the linkage cannot see.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is the registry's over-coverage, the persons it holds under two identifiers, which a register-quality analyst estimates rather than lists, worked here as the number of record pairs sharing a given name, a birth date and a sex in excess of the pairs the cohort's own name frequencies produce by coincidence; in another field's nouns there is no registry renewed under a changed surname, no birth cohort's name mix setting how often strangers share a birthday and a name, and the task stops reading the same.
layer1: the legacy registry extract in upper-case fixed formats (birth dates day-month-year, no diacritics, compound surnames run together) beside the new platform's mixed-case export with ISO dates and accents
status codes in two vocabularies (A, I, D against ACTIVE, LAPSED, DECEASED), with the legacy file frozen at the September cutover and the platform carrying later changes
deaths from the vital statistics feed applied to the platform only, a few weeks behind
postal codes with and without the space, and rural route addresses
renewals matched by the old health number carried on the platform record, and new applications carrying none
stakeholder_role: the authority's registry and decision support manager, who certifies the insured count the province's capitation round funds for 2027-28

spine.entity: one registration record on the new platform (an insured person as the platform holds them)

world.geography: Canada (a fictional regional health authority in a fictional province; the authority, the ministry, the vendor and the people are fictional)
world.org_type: a regional health authority that keeps the insured persons registry for its region

driver: The decisive quantity is how many people a register holds twice, under two identifiers whose names disagree, read as the excess of record pairs sharing a given name, a birth date and a sex over the pairs that coincidence produces in each birth year's own name frequencies; judged pair by pair, a disagreeing surname either makes every such pair two people or every one of them one person, and both miss the count by the coincidental pairs.
driver_concrete: The persons the registry holds twice are the same-given-name, same-birth-date, same-sex pairs across a surname change in excess of the pairs expected by chance from each birth year and sex's given-name counts, so the insured count is the de-duplicated records less that excess.
stump: A competent solver conforms both extracts, removes retired and deceased records, de-duplicates by health number and links probabilistically, and files the linked count; the step that lands it there is treating every pair that shares a given name, a birth date and a sex but not a surname as two people (or every one as a duplicate), when coincidence produces only part of those pairs in each birth cohort's name mix and the excess is the people registered twice.

lineage.architecture: v1 (the regional hospital bed-status feeds read through a latent class model of their agreement)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-01 at the batch 1 audit, never returned by the portal: short of the survivor anatomy on every line (the feeds' agreement pattern is the latent class model's own textbook input, so the field's method sat at the top of the ladder), an unmeasured ask ceiling, a prompt stating the feed count, and two pack files that describe the data (leak.py LEAK)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how often a state held in each group of units, seen only through three independent records that each miss some instances and flag some non-instances, one catching nearly every instance but also a third of non-instances and two rarely flagging a non-instance but missing most instances, so every rule that settles each unit from its records either keeps the first record's false flags or drops most instances, and only a latent class model of the three records, their miss and false-flag rates estimated from how they agree and the state's frequency free in each group, counts the instances.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst conforms the three feeds to hospital-days, counts a day full when any feed shows it full (the compact's 'at some time during the day') and activates all eight regions instead of four; the step that lands it there is settling each hospital-day from the feeds' flags instead of estimating each region's share of full days from a latent class model of how often each feed misses a full day or flags an ordinary one.
lineage.niche: a statewide hospital alliance's ICU surge compact, whose regional trigger counts full adult-ICU hospital-days that three conflicting capacity feeds (a 07:00 census survey, a transfer-status board, a transfer center's declines) each record imperfectly

lineage.architecture: v2 (a flexible packaging converter's 2026 VOC emissions against its 95-ton synthetic minor limit, the bypass read as the solvent above the oxidizer's air capacity)
lineage.fate: abandoned 2026-11-01 at stage 2, before any data was cut: the same emissions-inventory ETL cell as task468 architecture 6, registered 93 seconds later and built to stage 4 first; the cell was yielded to it
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a release a control device stops only up to a fixed capacity, set in one unit while the release accrues in another, the two tied by a setpoint every source holds; whenever the sources' combined demand passes the capacity the excess goes untreated, so the untreated amount is each interval's combined load above the capacity's equivalent in the release's unit, not the whole load while the relief stood open and not the average load over those intervals.
lineage.stump: A competent solver conforms the issues, the jobs and the oxidizer record and, reading the permit's bypass clause, counts as uncontrolled all the solvent the presses applied while the bypass damper stood open, or the plant's average application rate over those hours; the step that lands it there is treating the bypass as the presses' whole exhaust or their average, when the oxidizer kept treating its full air capacity throughout and each dryer's exhaust is held at a quarter of the LEL, so only the solvent above the capacity's solvent equivalent went untreated.
lineage.niche: a flexible packaging converter's 2026 actual VOC emissions under its synthetic minor permit, conformed from the ink room's issues and returns by press job, the presses' job logs, the regenerative thermal oxidizer's 15-minute record, the waste solvent shipments and the stack test, in the year a sixth press started up and the presses' combined dryer exhaust outran the oxidizer's air capacity at peak

differentiation.task455: task455 counts new administrative identifiers that continue an existing unit through a recorded continuity; here no record carries the continuity: the duplicates are counted, never listed, as an excess of coincidences over what each cohort's name mix produces.
differentiation.task157: task157 scales the pair defects a statutory sample catches by the square of its sampling fraction; here nothing is sampled: every record is present and the duplicates hide among genuine strangers who share a name and a birthday, separated only in number by the cohort's chance rate.
differentiation.task471: task471 completes a count from a census and an independent recount by their overlap; here there is one register and the error runs the other way, persons counted twice rather than missed.
differentiation.task98: task98 removes a population's members that two dated schedules both name, so the overlap is listed; here the overlap is never listed: the duplicates are counted only as an excess of chance coincidences of name and birthday.
differentiation.task192: task192 v1 counts distinct generating processes behind overlapping bursts from the interval each repeats on; here no process repeats: one person stands behind two records, and the count comes from how often strangers share a name and a birthday.
